title: Immunization Record Standard for the Dose Number on a Consent Form
content:
# Immunization Record Standard — the dose number on a screening and consent form

**Scope.** Immunization Services, all vaccinations: the dose number a screening and consent form names, and the course-history counts that dose numbering reads.

## 1. The dose number

**1.1** A screening and consent form names the dose of the course it covers. On a newly opened course the form covers dose 1.

## 2. Counts read from a course history

**2.1 Dose entries on record.** The dose entries on a course are the dose-given entries on its history, each dose-given entry counting once, whether it names a Kestrel store or was recorded from another provider (it names no Kestrel store).

**2.2 Doses Kestrel reported.** The doses Kestrel reported on a course are counted from the registry reports on its history — the entries showing that Kestrel reported a dose to the state immunization registry — one for each registry report.

**2.3 Positions held.** A dose entry holds a position in the series unless it carries an invalidation entry, is a plan-billed entry recorded from another provider, or is a cash-paid entry recorded from another provider without a lot number. The positions held on a course are therefore its dose entries on record, less one for each invalidation entry on its history, less its plan-billed entries recorded from another provider and its cash-paid entries recorded from another provider that carry no lot number, together with the positions that those plan-billed and cash-paid outside entries hold in their own right.

| Kind of dose entry on the course | Holds a position under 2.3 |
|---|---|
| Given at a Kestrel store, no invalidation entry against it | Yes, one |
| Recorded from another provider, cash-paid, carrying a lot number, no invalidation entry | Yes, one |
| Any dose entry that carries an invalidation entry | No |
| Recorded from another provider, plan-billed | Only the positions such entries hold in their own right |
| Recorded from another provider, cash-paid, no lot number | Only the positions such entries hold in their own right |

## 3. Hypothetical illustrations

*All figures below are hypothetical inputs chosen to show the definitions; they are not company values.*

- **A newly opened course.** A course opened today holds no dose entries. A form signed on it covers dose 1.
- **Counting positions.** A hypothetical course history shows three dose entries — two given at a Kestrel store and one cash-paid entry recorded from another provider carrying a lot number — and one invalidation entry against one of the Kestrel doses. It holds no plan-billed or undocumented outside entry. Positions held: three dose entries, less one for the invalidation entry, gives two positions.
- **Counting Kestrel's reports.** The same hypothetical history shows two registry reports. The doses Kestrel reported on that course number two.
